reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Primary proposed optogenetic pathway-necessity test during cue retrieval; evaluate the actual illumination site, physiological validation and behavioral controls selected in the answer.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult prior detailed Methods/supplements or validated protocols before implementation and verify transfer of conditions. Generic calibration or a validated tool label does not meet M.

The actual targeting/construct, delivery quantities and functional dose, expression interval and executable optical preparation remain unspecified; no concrete lookup/calibration procedure sets those core implementation values.

The criterion is promised but no quantitative accuracy/acceptance rule or procedure deriving it is supplied. Behavioral tracking also lacks independent detector/classifier validation against reference observations.
Correct/error/omission denominators are well defined, but missing/corrupted video, ambiguous choices and weak tracking signals have no explicit quantitative handling rule.
No actual multiplicity correction or gatekeeping procedure is named for planned timing and confound comparisons.

checks.quote: across a range of light intensities and durations
checks.reason: No bounded intensity/duration exploration or rule deriving safe search bounds and stop before confirmation.
Timestamps and objective recordings are useful but no complete animal/trial-to-raw-file manifest with acquisition, tracking, model, code and environment versions.
